text:
claire: heads up — NovaGrid (acct NG-900) invoice INV-2025-714 is 52 days past due. CFO replied asking to pay 40% now and remainder in 2 equal monthly installments. cc @dmitri @ana

dmitri: any disputes or credits? can we confirm ledger balance?

ana: small dispute about overage from March but it was denied; nothing pending on our side. outstanding shown = $30,000.

omkar: Finance here 2: conditional approval for split if we get card token or ACH, signed extension form, and upfront 40% within 7 business days. prefer ACH but card token acceptable.

claire: Sales says CFO prefers card. asked for invoice showing split and auto-charge consent. jess in CS already got an email "we'll provide card on file and sign" screenshot in #customer-docs.

billing-bot: created invoice revision INV-2025-714.rev1 with split schedule and added note to require payment method token. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2025-714/rev1 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Hold placed on aggressive escalation for NG-900 while PA pending. Reminder scheduled in 6 days.

dmitri: Omkar, can we approve waiving the late fee if they meet schedule?

omkar: OK to waive accrued late fee if PA signed and both subsequent payments clear within 5 days of due dates. final sign-off after we see the 40% txn id and token capture.

claire: I'll send PA + revised invoice. Sales to capture card token and upload signed form. escalate if no token or payment by next Thu. :thumbsup:
